_about: Hand-maintained inputs for scripts/notices.mjs: code and fonts inside the shipped binaries that the Go, npm and
cargo metadata cannot see, plus the programs that are run but not shipped. The native texts are inline because
skia-bindings downloads Skia as prebuilt static code, so there is no license file to read at check time. Each
entry says where its text came from. When skia-bindings or rquickjs-sys is upgraded, review this list and bump
"requires": scripts/notices.mjs fails while a required crate version is out of date.

native.note: skia-bindings links a prebuilt Skia (features jpeg-decode, jpeg-encode, pdf and textlayout) statically into {NAME}-edit, together with the libraries Skia bundles. QuickJS-ng is compiled from the copy vendored in rquickjs-sys.
